parameters.query:
UPDATE teachers_manager.ai_rate_limiter
SET last_request_at = now()
WHERE id = 1
  AND (last_request_at IS NULL OR now() - last_request_at >= ($1 || ' seconds')::interval)
RETURNING last_request_at;

INSERT INTO teachers_manager.ai_usage_daily (teacher_id, usage_date, request_count)
VALUES ($1::uuid, CURRENT_DATE, 1)
ON CONFLICT (teacher_id, usage_date)
DO UPDATE SET request_count = teachers_manager.ai_usage_daily.request_count + 1
WHERE teachers_manager.ai_usage_daily.request_count < $2
RETURNING request_count;

SELECT
  s.id, s.name, s.subject, s.current_topic, s.current_surah, s.current_from_ayah, s.current_to_ayah,
  (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(l)) FROM (
      SELECT lesson_date, lesson_content, memorization, recitation, performance, notes, next_assignment, homework
      FROM teachers_manager.lessons
      WHERE student_id = s.id AND teacher_id = s.teacher_id AND status = 'completed'
      ORDER BY lesson_date DESC LIMIT 3
  ) l) AS recent_lessons,
  (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(n)) FROM (
      SELECT note, created_at FROM teachers_manager.student_notes
      WHERE student_id = s.id AND teacher_id = s.teacher_id
      ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5
  ) n) AS notes
FROM teachers_manager.students s
WHERE s.id = $1::uuid AND s.teacher_id = $2::uuid;

SELECT c.content, c.chapter_title, c.page_number, c.book_id, b.title AS book_title
FROM teachers_manager.book_chunks c
JOIN teachers_manager.book_sources b ON b.id = c.book_id
WHERE c.teacher_id = $1::uuid
  AND b.status = 'ready'
  AND (
    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teachers_manager.book_student_links l WHERE l.book_id = b.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teachers_manager.book_student_links l WHERE l.book_id = b.id AND l.student_id = $2::uuid)
  )
ORDER BY c.embedding <=> $3::vector
LIMIT $4::integer;
